name: Madison Mobile Solar, LLC
old_description: Add solar power, lithium batteries and many other upgrades to your RV, trailer, van or skoolie.
about:
Madison Mobile Solar, LLC is based in Fitchburg, Wisconsin, and operates a year-round installation shop at 8710-2 Montclair Drive in Middleton. The company specializes in mobile solar and battery systems for recreational and commercial vehicles.

The business designs and builds complete electrical systems, handling everything from initial sizing and component selection to installation, programming, and customer training. It also troubleshoots and repairs underperforming setups and supports do-it-yourself projects with advice, key components, and programming assistance. As a certified Victron installer and an authorized dealer for Epoch Batteries and Rich Solar, the company stocks and supplies a range of inverters, charge controllers, lithium batteries, and solar panels.

Its customers include owners of RVs, trailers, vans, skoolies, and other mobile homes, as well as commercial vehicle operators seeking off-grid power solutions. The indoor shop allows work to continue through Wisconsin winters.

The company emphasizes safety compliance and customer education, teaching clients how to operate and manage their systems after installation.
